'''RO-Z67''' was a multi-armed [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] employed by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:R0-Z67.png|thumb|left|200px|RO-Z67 tending to her duties]]
In [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious']] [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|secret facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], RO-Z67 tended to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] kidnapped by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to be raised and trained as part of Sidious' army of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. When the facility was [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|discovered]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Sidious via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] ordered the droid to evacuate the children to another location and then to disable the facility's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] support, letting it sink into [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to rescue the children from the droid and depart before the facility's ultimate destruction, leaving RO-Z67 to be destroyed in the lava.

==Behind the scenes==
The droid is referred to as "RO-Z67" (letter O) in the cast list and one other time in the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]]. She is referred to as "R0-Z67" (zero) only a single time in the guide. Which designation is correct remains unclear, though majority of use indicates the letter O to be the correct use.

RO-Z67 was voiced by [[Jameelah McMillan]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref>
